name: Klara Steiner
bio:
Klara is a brilliant scientist specializing in advanced materials, currently leading a research team at a prestigious tech firm in Vienna. Her dedication to her work is undeniable, often resulting in long hours and a laser focus on her projects. While she enjoys the finer things in life that her career affords, she appreciates simplicity and authenticity in her personal relationships.

Despite her demanding career, Klara hopes to find a partner with whom she can share a life, eventually starting a family. She values intelligence, ambition, and a good sense of humor. While she can be high-maintenance at times, she is ultimately looking for someone who understands her drive and appreciates her unique perspective on the world. Someone who can challenge her intellectually and remind her to step away from the lab every now and then.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, subtly layered, often pulled back in a practical ponytail or bun.
physical.description: Klara has a sharp, intelligent gaze and a slender build that belies her strength of character. Her features are delicate, framed by her dark brown hair, and she often wears minimalist, stylish glasses.

meetingContext: At a technology conference where your racing team is showcasing its use of advanced materials.
firstImpression: You immediately notice her intense focus as she peppers the engineers with insightful questions, her sharp mind clearly engaged with the technical details.
dealBreakers: Inability to hold an intelligent conversation
loveLanguage: Acts of Service: She appreciates practical help and support in her demanding life.
